messages:
sam (support): Hey team, customer C-402 reports large tail latency + occasional 0-dim errors on /v1/embeddings after yesterday's runtime deploy. They see spikes when small high-frequency clients and large batched jobs run together.

sam (support): Example error from their client: `embedding dim mismatch: expected 1536 but got 768` and intermittent requests timing out (~10s). They provided a short repro.

sam (support): Repro request (pseudocode):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "open-sim-1536",
  "input": ["short text 1", "short text 2", ... many tiny reqs sent in quick succession],
  "client_batching": false
}
```

sam (support): Observed behavior: small single-input requests get coalesced into tiny batches; large batch jobs (client-side 128) sometimes get split across shards and then delayed waiting for coalesce window. End result: long tail for the big job + some 0-dim errors that look like payload truncation or a shard route picking wrong model variant.

maria (infra): Thanks, gathering logs from the shard pool now. Any `max_batch_size` values for that route?

sam (support): Customer route config shows `max_batch_size: 64`, dynamic batching enabled, per-shard override = 8 on three older GPUs (ha node pool).

kevin (eng-runtime): That mismatch is suspicious — per-shard override of 8 will force many splits. If a large client requests 128, runtime may split into 8/8/8/... across many shards; combined with coalesce window and priority preemption, it can increase tail latency. The 0-dim could be a deserialization bug when splitting payloads quickly.

dan (eng-ml): Also check model variant mapping. If one shard is serving a quantized 768-dim variant (for cost), a mis-routed slice could cause the dim mismatch. We had a fallback mapping change in the deploy.

maria (infra): infra-bot: collected logs: `route=embeds-prod pool=shard-3 shard_override=8 coalesce_ms=12 split_count=16 trace=abc123`. Sending logs to thread.

kevin (eng-runtime): Repro attempt on staging: sending mixed small+large workload reproduces tail spikes. I can reproduce 10s tail when small req flood occurs at ~2k rps.

kevin (eng-runtime): Quick mitigations:
- bump per-shard override to match `max_batch_size` (set overrides to 64)
- increase `coalesce_ms` a bit (e.g., 20ms) for this route to favor batch completion
- enable `priority_tagging` so large client gets preference OR configure `client_priority` for reserved capacity

sam (support): Sent these to customer as immediate workarounds. They want a safe short-term change we can apply without a full deploy.

maria (infra): I can push a runtime config update to the pool to align per-shard override -> 64 (hotpatch). Will monitor metrics and rollback if any regressions.

dan (eng-ml): Long term we should add a guard: when splitting, include model-variant metadata with slices and validate dims on reassembly to avoid 0-dim errors. I'll open a ticket for validation + unit tests.

kevin (eng-runtime): Also adding a traceable header so we can correlate slice-level failures back to the parent request.

sam (support): Customer accepted hotpatch. I'll update in the portal and keep them posted. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria (infra): infra-bot: applied override hotpatch to shard pool `embeds-prod` -> per_shard_max=64. Watching 10m window.

kevin (eng-runtime): After hotpatch, staging repro shows median tail drop from ~9.8s to ~200ms for the large job. No 0-dim errors seen in last 5m.

sam (support): Posting resolution to customer and closing escalation if no new errors. Will follow up on dan's validation ticket.

dan (eng-ml): ticket #INFR-842 added: "slice-dim-validation + trace headers".

sam (support): Thanks everyone. If it resurfaces I'll re-open.
